levels.surface: عبد الله بن عبد الرحمن بن أبزى

notes: Two routes leave Sufyan («عن سلمة، عن أبي مالك» and «وعن عبد الله بن عبد الرحمن بن أبزى») and meet at the shared tail «عن عبد الرحمن بن أبزى», written once (rule 3). The tail is occurrence 2 of that phrase.
«قال كنا عند عمر» : Umar is a place, not a link (rule 6). Abd al-Rahman ibn Abza is the narrator.
«فقال عمار بن ياسر» speaks inside the account. Rule 6 does not settle whether a companion speaking in the story is a further link, so he is not added (needs_ruling).
